inputs.name: briefing
inputs.description: A funder's or buyer's briefing deck for a call for funding or a tender, as a PDF

inputs.name: criteria
inputs.description: The company's bid criteria: who it is, each criterion and what meets it, and its rules for the recommendation and the questions

inputs.name: briefing_date
inputs.description: A calendar date, optionally with a time of day — as precise as its source states.

output.description: A go/no-go sheet for a briefing: the opportunity, a recommendation by the company's rule, a row per criterion, and the questions

fields.name: opportunity
fields.description: The call or topic assessed, as the deck names it

fields.name: recommendation
fields.description: Whether to bid, by the company's rule

fields.name: summary
fields.description: The criteria met, the gap that decides the bid, and what must be settled before committing

fields.name: criteria
fields.description: One row per bid criterion, in the criteria's order

fields.name: questions
fields.description: The questions to settle before bidding, each with whom to ask
